name: investment.holdings

list.description: Query native investment records in the declared scope.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Portfolio snapshot date (YYYY-MM-DD), independent of row valueDate.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Exact native currency; repeatable local selection.

parameters.name: product-code
parameters.description: Exact native product code; repeatable local selection.

get.description: Read one native root detail online without changing a saved List.

lookup.name: orderId
lookup.description: Native lookup sent as orderId; use the unprojected List investmentNo value.

result_identity.description: Native detail orderId; exact nonempty string echo of the requested lookup.

purpose: Inspect native investment business records through inquiry-only endpoints.
limitations: JSON POST /portfolioQueryList.json; fixed tenant GUAPW3SG; rowStart offsets of width 500; data.data and fixed data.totalCount.
Native fields, amounts, rates, nulls, unknown fields and response order are retained without conversion.

The host List SDK deduplicates native identities and uses the last arrival for conflicting records; conflicts or count gaps remain incomplete. Only complete nonempty refresh publishes; empty, failed or incomplete refresh preserves the previous snapshot. Live never publishes.
Installation initializes an empty binding only; explicit sync uses the declared acquisition and publication policy.
Fixed status=[ACTIVE, INACTIVE]. date selects the complete portfolio snapshot, never a row valueDate filter.
Native Get uses POST form /queryIncrementOrderDetail.json; lookup orderId returns one native root object with orderId.
Get preserves all native nested fields and unknown values; separately queried history, logs and child endpoints remain unqueried.
Get is live-only and publishes no cache or Duckdog data.

List --live --with-detail fetches native Detail only for the selected offset/limit window, returns separate record/detail members and fails atomically on any detail error; saved List data remains unchanged.

examples.title: Read one selected List row with its native detail

sync.evidence: Native record identity: investmentNo. Complete acquisition uses the declared native List collector and its scope/completeness evidence. Each dated result is a snapshot of its selected query day; returned row dates are not the snapshot identity.

time.basis: Portfolio snapshot date (YYYY-MM-DD), independent of row valueDate.
